about: The secreta of the formulary “Second Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Look graciously, we beseech Thee, O Lord, upon the present sacrifices, that they may profit both our devotion and our salvation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
